Definition: from G447; relaxation or (figuratively) relief:--eased, liberty, rest.
BiblicalUsage: Relief, rest, ease after pressure. Paul finds no rest for his spirit in Troas, the churches are promised rest with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed, and Felix keeps Paul in liberty, giving him leave to receive his friends. The word is the loosening of a grip.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe rest is one of God's promises, not a luxury: the rest He gives now to troubled spirits and the rest He will give when Christ is revealed. Paul's restless spirit in Troas is honest about the waiting, and I hold that the waiting itself ends in rest.
